system.description:
Iron Skeleton. Your first Armour Slot is never destroyed or repaired; heal its wounds like Health Points. Push-backs move you half as far. No abilities that need a physical body (e.g. Beast Mode).

Uncanny Valley (Flaw). Lose 1 Skill Die on Heart Checks to charm others. If you fail such a Check, the target must make a Fear Check.

SHIVER Core Rulebook p.92

automation.note: Your first Armour Slot can't be destroyed or repaired. Heal its wounds as if they were Health Points.
Effects that push you back move you half the distance.
You can't take abilities that need a physical body, such as Beast Mode.

system.flawSummary: Lose 1 Skill Die on Heart Checks to charm others. If you fail such a Check, the target must make a Fear Check.
system.flawDescription: Lose 1 Skill Die on Heart Checks to charm others. If you fail such a Check, the target must make a Fear Check.

flawAutomation.note: If you fail a Heart Check to charm someone, they must make a Fear Check (the Director sets the CR).
